name: Edamam Recipe Search
tagline: Recipe and nutrition search API with ingredients, diets, and health filters
description: Edamam Recipe Search API lets developers query a large recipe database by keyword, ingredients, diet, allergies, and nutrition constraints. Responses include recipe metadata, ingredient lines, nutrition estimates, and source links. Commonly used for meal planners, recipe apps, and food discovery features.

auth.details: Application ID and Application Key as query params (app_id, app_key) after self-serve developer signup

use_cases: search recipes by ingredient or keyword
filter recipes by diet allergy or calorie range
fetch nutrition estimates for a recipe
